name: Hibrinix SEO
author: hibrinix

sections.description:
Hibrinix SEO delivers enterprise-grade search optimization, automated JSON-LD structured data, non-destructive PageSpeed acceleration, and deep on-page competitor audits in a single lightweight, secure WordPress client plugin.

Key Capabilities

  • Server-Backed NVIDIA Semantic AI: Powered by the central Hibrinix infrastructure (https://seo.hibrinix.com/api/v1). Eliminates master API key exposure on customer WordPress sites.
  • Deterministic Offline Fallbacks: Operates seamlessly even if network connectivity is interrupted.
  • Performance Suite: Built-in WebP image conversion, local image compression, full-page caching, Gzip compression, and asset deferrals.
  • Page Builder & Elementor Safeguards: Strictly non-destructive. Preserves Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg blocks, and WooCommerce checkout flows with automatic rollback snapshots.
  • Full Coexistence Mode: Operates harmoniously alongside Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, or SEOPress without duplicate frontend tags.

External Services

This plugin integrates with external cloud services to provide search intelligence, AI generation, and performance auditing:

  1. Hibrinix Central API (https://seo.hibrinix.com/api/v1)

    • Purpose: Centralized license verification, schema graph coordination, and server-side AI processing.
    • Data Sent: Site URL, post titles, and meta excerpts when requesting optimization or checking license status. No database passwords or sensitive credentials are ever sent.
    • Terms of Service: https://seo.hibrinix.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://seo.hibrinix.com/privacy

  2. Google PageSpeed Insights API (https://www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed)

    • Purpose: Analyzes frontend URLs to return Lighthouse performance, accessibility, best practices, and SEO diagnostic scores.
    • Data Sent: The public URL of the post or page being audited.
    • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  3. NVIDIA NIM Cloud AI (https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions)

    • Purpose: Optional direct generative AI completions (e.g. meta descriptions, structured content recommendations) when user configures an NVIDIA API key.
    • Data Sent: Content excerpts and post titles for text completion.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/legal-info/
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/about-nvidia/privacy-policy/

  4. Third-Party Script Optimization Match List (Local Rules)

    • Note on Scanned Needles: Domain strings such as connect.facebook.net, google-analytics.com, and clarity.ms referenced in class-site-optimizer.php are purely local URL matching needles used by the delay manager to defer third-party analytics until user interaction. They are not outbound API requests made by the plugin, but rather client-side scripts delayed to improve Core Web Vitals (INP/LCP/TBT).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hibrinix-seo directory to /wp-content/plugins/ (or install the zip via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate Hibrinix SEO in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Hibrinix SEO > License to view your active plan status.
  4. Review Hibrinix SEO > Settings to customize your business schema profile.
